data.text:
Zoya Ventures Real Estate, a trailblazer in the UAE’s real estate industry, recently hosted its much-anticipated annual awards ceremony on January 19, 2023, at the prestigious Banyan Tree-Bluewaters Island. More than 250 employees joined in the opulent celebration of excellence and achievements. The event showcased stellar performances across diverse departments and paid tribute to the star real estate brokers.

A Night to Remember

Zoya Ventures Real Estate’s annual awards have become a signature brand event, serving as a platform to recognize and honor top-performing teams and employees. This year's gathering was a tribute to the company's unwavering commitment to innovation and growth. 

Banyan Tree-Bluewaters Island provided a splendid backdrop for employees raising glasses to their collective success. Applause echoed through the venue as Zoya Ventures Real Estate's finest were recognized for their outstanding contributions to the company's exceptional growth trajectory.

What an Incredible 2023 It Turned Out To Be!    

2023 wasn't just a year; it was a blockbuster! We soared to new heights, closing deals worth a staggering 11 billion! But that's not all – we also proudly claimed the throne for selling the most expensive penthouse in Dubai and the 3rd most expensive penthouse worldwide!

Can you say EPIC?!

The evening was marked by the recognition of Zoya Ventures Real Estate's STAR real estate brokers, who made this happen. The spotlight shone brightly on those who consistently demonstrated excellence in their field, significantly contributing to Zoya Ventures Real Estate's position as a leader in the real estate industry.

data.text:
Looking Ahead to 2024

As Zoya Ventures Real Estate reflects on the achievements of 2023, the company also sets its sights on the future with ambitious plans for 2024. The Annual Awards Ceremony introduced the exciting endeavors that lie ahead, showcasing Zoya Ventures Real Estate's commitment to continuous growth, innovation, and excellence in the real estate sector.

Loai Al Fakir, CEO of Zoya Ventures Real Estate, expressed immense pride in the employees' achievements in 2023, stating, "As we step into 2024, we are excited about the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead. Zoya Ventures Real Estate is ready for another year of remarkable accomplishments, and we look forward to achieving new heights together."

About Zoya Ventures Real Estate

Established in 2008, Zoya Ventures Real Estate is a one-stop shop for real estate. With a resolution to offer 5-star service, Zoya Ventures Real Estate caters to property requirements and queries, providing hassle-free, tailored real estate advice and consultancy. The diverse team, with over 22 nationalities, is ready to answer property-related questions.

Services provided by Zoya Ventures Real Estate include buying, leasing, property management, finding the correct financing options, and even locating the perfect holiday home. The company prides itself on transparency, honesty, and professionalism to deliver the best results to clients.

As Zoya Ventures Real Estate looks back on 2023's success, the Annual Awards Ceremony is a testament to the company's dedication to excellence. With an eye on the future, Zoya Ventures Real Estate is poised for another year of remarkable accomplishments, ready to guide clients through the evolving landscape of sustainable real estate investments.
